card.name: Inside brand and drug names
card.fires_on: The pole responds to an early piece of a longer brand or drug name, where the rest of the name is still to come. Examples are the SE in Seleucus, the V in Spravato or Bupivacaine, and se in selegiline.

modes.label: Brand names in capitals
modes.description: Middle piece of an all-caps brand name such as KRYSTEXXA, SPRAVATO, BENLYSTA or ONPATTRO.

modes.description: Opening piece of selegiline or bupivacaine, where the name continues after the marked piece.

modes.label: Ancient names
modes.description: Start of a capitalized historical name in a non-drug passage.
modes.example: who bore the general name of either<< SE>>LEUCUS or ANTIOCHUS

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing a name with a syllable such as odo, ado or da.
card.plain: It fires partway through a long drug or brand name, before the name is finished.
